card.name: University course codes and student pages
card.fires_on: Digits or spaces inside university course codes (CSE 341, ECE 4180, ATM S 211) and student ID digits in campus web addresses. Also dates and terms in academic schedules.

modes.label: Course code digits
modes.description: A digit or space inside a course number such as CSE 341 or ECE 4180.
modes.example: CSE 34<<1>> -- Programming Languages Department of Computer Science

modes.label: Student ID in campus URL
modes.description: A digit inside a student number in a university home-page address.

modes.label: Academic schedule details
modes.description: A date or term marker in a course schedule or syllabus.
modes.example: EDU8111 Emerging Environments for Learning |Semester 3<<,>> 2012 Online Toowo

card.writes: It pushes toward student and academic words such as Autumn, @student and студент, and away from alignment words.
card.plain: It fires on course numbers and student IDs in university pages and syllabi.
